verdict.rationale: Composio's own CLI can 'inspect schemas' for tools in its 1000+ app catalog, and sessions can discover tools across that catalog, which covers the tools and input-schema part of the story. Composio is a tool catalog rather than a registry of independently listed servers, and its own MCP endpoints are hosted by Composio. Missing for 10: inspection of transport and hosting attributes per listed server, explicit confirmation that schemas can be inspected before connecting an account, a documented registry/listing view of servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect a listed server's tools, input schemas, transport, and hosting attributes before connecting to it

citations.quote: connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, call authenticated APIs, and debug Composio projects
Your agent can discover and use any of them through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.
